Have you ever wondered why even the smartest people sometimes struggle with decisions—why we get stuck overthinking, or miss the obvious right in front of us?
Welcome to a journey where we'll dive into the surprising science behind every choice we make, big or small. Together, we’re about to explore the hidden forces that shape our judgment, those subtle traps that can cloud our thinking without us even realizing it.
You and I will walk through the ideas brought to life in Decisive: How to Make Better Choices in Life and Work by Chip Heath. His work uncovers why bias, overconfidence, and narrow perspectives sneak into our decision-making—even when we know better.
Along the way, we’ll look at real stories, eye-opening research, and practical strategies that challenge what we think we know about making decisions. Instead of just picking between a couple of options, imagine learning how to see more possibilities, question your assumptions, and spot the common mental traps before they trip you up.
Think of this as more than just a guide to making choices. It’s an invitation to rethink how you approach every crossroads, at work and in life. By the end, you’ll be ready to make decisions with more confidence and clarity—and maybe even enjoy the process a little more.
So, are you ready to discover new ways to turn tough decisions into opportunities for growth? Let’s get started—together.
